name: diagrams-codex
description: Socle technique du convertisseur de diagrammes d’activité en SVG.

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others --names serveur-ts,navigateur-ts,serveur "tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "node --watch dist/server/index.js"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json
scripts.test:desktop: npm run build && npm run desktop:build:spark && node scripts/test-desktop-native.mjs
